title: Randomized acceptance value
statement: Let $P$ be a sign predicate of arity $k$, and assign each input position $i$ a mean parameter $\mu_i\in[-1,1]$. Sample the $k$ signs independently, with the sign at position $i$ drawn from the sign distribution of mean $\mu_i$, and evaluate the probability that $P$ accepts the resulting tuple.
hypotheses_covered: A mean parameter in $[-1,1]$ for every predicate input position
